{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "하루 한 번씩은 꼭 하려고"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "해외 갈 때도 챙기고"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "팩을 하고 나면 기초가 좀"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "느낌이 드는 것 같아서"}
